integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the evaluation code. Exact rank tests on every 8-subset and 9-subset of the 16 projective column types prove the third generalized Hamming weight and count all minimizers. A standalone verifier then constructs all 1920 natural symmetry actions and checks the orbit partition.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the q=3, m=5, d=2, r=3 torus code in Example 4.6. The orbit classification is with respect to the natural signed-coordinate-permutation subgroup of order 1920; a larger automorphism group could fuse natural orbits.
title: The 750 minimizers of Example 4.6 split into four natural orbits
